label: FP
reason: The user-supplied cookie value is decoded, processed by Thing.doSomething, then passed to ESAPI.encodeForHTML before being written to the response. encodeForHTML properly escapes HTML special characters, preventing XSS. The sink is the response writer, but the data is sanitized, so no vulnerability.

evidence.note: Output uses ESAPI.encoder().encodeForHTML(new String(input)) to escape the value before writing to the response.
